body:
Full-codebase review, operator-documentation gaps in server/README.md, all verified as absent:

* "Deployment requirements" covers TLS, rate-limiting, HSTS and ProxyFix but never names a WSGI server or a worker model, and never says that WAL allows a single writer — while `503 server_busy` is documented as a normal answer. It should say what to run it under and what concurrency to expect.
* It does not say the database file must be on a local filesystem. WAL over NFS or SMB corrupts.
* "install the new wheel and restart" is the documented upgrade, which under a rolling multi-worker restart is exactly the migration race in the migrations ticket. Say to stop the workers, or make migrations safe under concurrency (preferably both).
* The audit-log example uses a plain FileHandler with no rotation, and every 401/403 writes a record.
* `sqlite3`, the CLI the backup recipe depends on, is an undeclared prerequisite.
title: Operator docs: worker model, WAL single writer, local filesystem, rolling upgrades, log rotation
